errors.evidence: The description states the value for 2015 is approximately 0.25%, but the data point is visibly below the midpoint between 0.00% and 0.50%, placing it closer to 0.20%.

The description claims the value remains almost unchanged in 2016. However, the graph clearly shows a decrease from the 2015 value (approx. 0.2%) to a new low in 2016 (approx. 0.1%). This misrepresents the visual trend.
The description reports the value for 2018 as approximately 2.50%, but the data point is visibly above the 2.50% grid line, closer to 2.60%.
